name: Gobbless Choco Chill Cake
ingredients_raw: Refined Wheat Flour (maida), Sugar, Eggs, Edible Hydrogenated Vegetable Oil & Refined Palmolein Oil, Humectants [420(i), 422], High Maltose Syrup, Liquid Glucose, Cocoa Sloids(2%), Sweetened Condensed Milk, Colours(150c, 150d, 102, 122, 132 & 133), Cake Gel { Emulsifiers & Stabilizers(471 & 477) And Humectand[420(ii)]}, Raising Agents[341(i) & 500(ii)], Invert Sugar Syrup, Iodised Salt,preservatives(202 & 282), Baking Powder, Plain Chocolate(0.14%)[sugar, Cocoa Butter, Cocoa Solids, Emulsifiers[322(i) & 476] And Artificial (vanilla) Flavouring Substance], Flavours[nature Identical And Artificial (vanilla & Chocolate) Flavouring Substances] And Stabilizer (415).
